principles: Close only scanner-visible high gaps that belong to proof admissibility version support.
Prefer real verifier semantics over annotation-only closure when the contract is partial.
Keep schema and contract behavior stable where implementation already exists.
drivers: The next server receipt cleanup depends on a tight local admissibility boundary

options.name: A: Add verifier version support and scanner-visible facts
pros: Closes the real semantic gap and the mapping gaps together
cons: Requires touching core admissibility API and smoke expectations

options.name: B: Add only annotations
cons: Leaves verifierVersionSupported as a real correctness hole

options.name: C: Refactor gap_analyze matching
cons: Changes scanner semantics beyond this story scope and could mask real gaps

chosen: A: Add verifier version support and scanner-visible facts
rationale: Option A is the narrowest path that addresses both classes of issue: four requirements already have implementation but need scanner-visible facts, while verifierVersionSupported needs a real support check before the local admissibility contract is credible.

preMortem.scenario: Scanner still reports the same five gaps after code changes
preMortem.trigger: Annotations do not include the exact requirement keywords extracted from the decision document
preMortem.mitigation: Use explicit @task titles/descriptions/changes containing supportedSchemaVersion, verifierVersionSupported, contractVersionSupported, unsupported_schema_version, and unsupported_contract_version; rerun gap_analyze before DONE

preMortem.scenario: Verifier version support rejects valid existing artifacts
preMortem.trigger: New verifier allowlist is required but callers do not pass verifierVersion
preMortem.consequence: False blocks in current local admissibility consumers
preMortem.mitigation: Add verifierVersion as optional except for surfaces/checks that provide supported versions, or default surfaces to an explicit current verifier version with tests

preMortem.scenario: Story accidentally includes server receipt demotion work
preMortem.trigger: Production completion cleanup is adjacent in the same files
preMortem.consequence: Scope expands and review cannot isolate the five high gaps
preMortem.mitigation: Keep Authority/server receipt changes out of B-fbfb and reserve them for the second story after high gaps close
